generalCriterionList.description: The complete authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason
Conditional tender will not be considered
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
DePeriod for completion of this work is 3 Months. partment Registration Details
The contractor has produce all the Original documents at the time of opening of tender or Afterwords for Verification.
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing E-procurement portal.
The Contractor must have KPWD/KTTP PWD Civil Class-IV & above Registration.
The Contractor shall be responsible for the safety of all activities on the Site.
All the Relevant Documents as per KW-1 need to be uploaded while submitting bid in general documents provision in e-procurement portal.
Payment of work is done after Quality control and third party inspection Report.
Contractor Must follow the terms and conditions given by town Panchayat as and when.
All workdone certificates should be signed by Executive Engineer or above Rank.
Contractor Must submit his last 5 year Turnover Certificate Signed by C.A.
Contractor Must Submit his GST, Income Tax Certificate.
Contractor Must submit Line of Credit of Rs. 30% of Tender Amount from Nationalised Bank
